svg.title: App Template
svg.desc: Brand MARK (square, no wordmark) — exported as BRAND_LOGO from app-config/branding.ts and used as the PWA icon. Keep it square and wordmark-free: both app shells render the product name next to this image from `brandLabel` (theme/appTheme.ts), so a lockup with built-in text would show the name twice, and the PWA manifest declares `purpose: "any maskable"`, which requires a square icon. The wordmark lockup lives separately in the backend PDF report logo.
